name: Short link, counter-rotating — upper link drives
note: Counter-rotating short-link layout with the shock on the upper link. The rear triangle is one rigid piece joining the axle, FP and LP. A short lower link (MP to FP, about 105mm) runs back from a low main pivot behind the seat tube. A short upper link (SP to LP, about 67mm) sits wholly ahead of the seat tube, pivoting on a bracket welded to its front side; the shock eye SE sits on that upper link just forward of SP and the 210mm shock runs down to a down-tube mount 40mm off the centreline. The lower and upper links rotate in opposite directions over travel.
